question: Devka Beach, a beautiful expanse of black sand is located in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devka Beach **is a **breathtaking sight.**
 
• It is located in **Daman.**
 
• This is **massive, picturesque and quite unspoilt**.
 
• Other beaches in Daman are **Jampore Beach, Vanakbara Beach, Ghoghla Beach, Nagoa Beach and Tithal Beach**.
